newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks close up a sliver in guarded trade.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks close up a sliver in guarded trade.

text.p: Shares on the Lima Stock Exchange edged up slightly Wednesday in a thin session marked by cautious bargain-buying, brokers said.

"The purchases continue to be very selective, although today it was stronger at the close," said Israel Menor, of Divisas y Valores brokerage. "This leads us to think that shares will recover a bit more on Thursday."
The General Index advanced a nominal 0.04 percent to 1,538.69 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index gained 0.09 percent to 2,217.10 points.
In a total of 1,058 trades, volume was estimated at 21.6 million soles ($8.2 million).
Benchmark Telefonica del Peru benefited from gains in its ADR in New York, with the local stock rising 0.35 percent to 5.81 soles on 1.3 million shares.

Among other leaders, Cementos Lima gained 2.97 percent to 4.51 soles in trade of 162,981 shares, while electricity generator Edegel ended stable at 1.23 soles in 121,005 shares, and electricity distributor Edelnor fell 1.23 percent to 2.41 soles on 72,798 share-volume.

"Local investors are still waiting for some news that favors their interests before they begin trading more strongly," said Jose Carranza, of Plusvalor brokerage. "However, there should soon be a jump in the market thanks to the better long-term prospects."
